visual.name: finWaterfall
visual.description: IBCS waterfall: profit cascade, plan-to-actual variance bridge and cash bridge

dataRoles.name: rows
dataRoles.description: One or two levels. In cascade mode the first level holds the result names (e.g. Gross Profit) and the second the items that lead to them.

dataRoles.name: pm
dataRoles.description: Optional. When bound the chart bridges from the comparison total to the actual total.

dataRoles.name: start
dataRoles.description: Optional. When bound the chart bridges from the opening balance through the flows to the closing balance.
